acceptanceCriteria: safePath refuses any path whose first component is .git (case-folded), with a named code, and tests cover docs --page, docs --claims and record.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the AFU-V1 S6 review (PR #202, V1-0253), deferred there. `corvint flows docs --page/--claims` and `flows record` confine writes with the shared `safePath` helper, which does not refuse paths under `.git/`. A write command can therefore place files inside the Git directory.
title: flows: --page, --claims and record accept output paths under .git/
